description: User-facing filter aliases -> the canonical filter key used by the KPI configs (config/*.json 'filters.allowed'). Each config maps that key to its own physical column + filter_type, so aliases stay stable across KPIs even where the underlying column differs (e.g. risk -> risk_description). Matching is case-insensitive and folds spaces/underscores/hyphens; the canonical key itself is always accepted. No alias may map to two keys (validated at load).
